content: Knowledge conflict research (arXiv DRAGged into Conflicts 2506.08500 / Google Research; ConflictRAG 2605.17301; Contradiction Detection in RAG 2504.00180). Two conflict classes: context-memory (retrieved vs parametric) and context-context (retrieved docs contradict each other). Inter-document conflicts subtype into factual, temporal, and opinion conflicts - temporal is the common real-world case and is NOT a true contradiction, it is staleness. Pipeline shape that works: detect -> classify -> resolve -> generate, with cheap embedding/MLP classifier first and selective LLM refinement only on candidates. Key empirical finding: explicitly telling the LLM the conflict CATEGORY significantly improves response quality - so surfacing 'these two sources disagree on a date' beats a generic disputed flag. Source ranking by reliability reduces conflict impact.
